verdict.rationale: The only bulk evidence is a documented bulk upload process for equity promises (docs-4). The Gusto sync automates employee and equity data transfer that would otherwise be entered by hand (docs-17), which reduces repetitive work but is not a bulk operation itself. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, llms.txt or markdown docs, so there is no evidenced programmatic path for an AI-native user to run bulk actions. Missing for 10: bulk operations beyond equity promise uploads (e.g. bulk grants, edits or approvals), any API or scriptable interface for batch actions, documentation of bulk-operation scope and limits, and independent corroboration.
